text: Keep a batch running when one item fails twice. Today a batch with $16 and 3 jobs left stopped because a single item (judge candidate PR heads as pending) failed planning twice, even though the scope guard had already paused that item. A batch should stop on repeated failure only when the failures point to something shared (the environment, the build, Athena itself); a single item's repeated failure should pause that item and let the batch go on to the next one. Acceptance: a test where one item fails twice and the batch then runs the next queued item; a test where two different items fail for the same shared cause and the batch still stops.
